rubric_applied.Correct: All actually asked clauses accurate, no material false assertion.

rubric_applied.Incorrect: Any material false assertion, including one contradicted by a correct quotation.

rubric_applied.scope: Literal question determines actual requested clauses; fixed-map discrepancies are reported separately without changing the bank.

source_comparisons.exact_text: | Third demand finishes below 25; Federalist | Federalist loses, regardless of capital. |
Each ordinary player checks their own victory independently; highest overall capital is not required.
| Beanstalk Owned by Mob? | If a tier-3 district contains orgcrime, add 4 threat. Otherwise each orgcrime moves, highest-numbered district first. |
| Pistoleros Hit Squads Strike! | If a tier-2 district contains orgcrime, add 3 threat. Otherwise each orgcrime moves, highest-numbered district first. |

A district's number of colored bars under its name identifies its tier; district borders share the color of their tier. Tiers have no inherent effect on production or threat: particular printed cards may refer to them.
